headline: US Supreme Court rejects Trump bid to invalidate California ballots
summary: The US Supreme Court rejected an appeal by Donald Trump's campaign to invalidate early ballots from approximately 20,000 voters in California as voters headed to the polls.
why: Legal rulings surrounding electoral procedures during national voting dates create critical political certainty and influence macroeconomic policy expectations.

impacts.name: United States
impacts.why: Supreme Court decision affects national election proceedings.
